note: Per-citation lock: claim hash + cited-line hashes as of the generated date, plus a TextQuoteSelector second anchor per citation (dual anchoring). CHANGED means the cited content differs — re-verify the claim by hand; MOVED means the same passage lives at a new range (re-run build to re-lock); AMBIGUOUS means the quoted passage occurs more than once and its context cannot disambiguate it. The manifest records each source's converter identity where the record supports one (unknown-legacy where it does not). Patterns: tng-wiki lockfile (MIT), okf-harness manifest (Apache-2.0), zissa-wiki quote check (MIT), wiki-skills audit (MIT), KNOX converter identity (MIT), W3C Web Annotation selectors — all re-implemented.
